git_branch_checked_out_in: Error toast when switching to a branch another worktree has checked out.
git_branch_create_from: Description of the Create branch row: the branch it starts from.
git_branch_create_from_head: Description of the Create branch row when HEAD is detached.
git_branch_create_label: Row of the branch picker that creates a branch from the typed name.
git_branch_created: Success toast after creating a branch from the picker.
git_branch_group_create: Group title of the Create branch row in the branch picker.
git_branch_group_local: Group title in the branch picker.
git_branch_group_remote: Group title in the branch picker.
git_branch_row_checked_out: Part of a branch row's description: another worktree has it checked out. {worktree} is that worktree's folder name.
git_branch_row_current: Part of a branch row's description in the picker: this is the checked out branch.
git_branch_stash_confirm: Confirm button when switching branches with uncommitted work in the way.
git_branch_stash_question: Confirm dialog body, after git's own message about the files in the way.
git_branch_stash_title: Confirm dialog title when switching branches with uncommitted work in the way.
git_branch_switched_stashed: Success toast after switching branches with the changes stashed.
git_branch_unknown_checkout: Error toast when picking a branch another worktree has checked out and Atlas has no project at that path.
